line.name: Alfonso Gran Selección
line.description: Companion/darker blend to the Extra Añejo, using extended cedar + French oak aging. Produced at Tabacos de Costa Rica. 25 cigars/box.
line.filler: Dominican & Nicaraguan (one source: Dominican & Peruvian - minor cross-source discrepancy)

research_notes: Mac folder's 'Gc-*' filenames (Gc-Enormes, Gc-Estelares, Gc-Exclusivos, Gc-Preciosos, Alf-Gc-Gran) could not be tied to any confirmed official sub-name - no source uses a term like 'Gran Clásico'. Treated as duplicate single-cigar/pack photography of the same Gran Selección vitolas (as opposed to the box-open photos), not a separate line. Flagged as moderate-confidence, not certain.
